ValidationRule.description: VR-OPP-20: Opportunity currency must be the Operation Country's local currency (country map) or USD. Rebased off the subsidiary currency field so USD-billing entities in non-USD countries pass.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Operation_Country__c))), TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) <> CASE(TEXT(Operation_Country__c), "China", "CNY", "India", "INR", "Indonesia", "IDR", "Japan", "JPY", "Korea", "KRW", "South Korea", "KRW", "Hong Kong", "HKD", "Singapore", "SGD", "Malaysia", "MYR", "Philippines", "PHP", "Thailand", "THB", "USD"), TEXT(CurrencyIsoCode) <> "USD" )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunity Currency must be the operation country's local currency or USD. Set the currency to the local currency or USD, or change the Operation Country.
